title: SweetDreams
description: Send your players to the dreamlands when they sleep!
body:
# SweetDreams
This plugin disables traditional sleeping in favor of taking your players to a whole new adventure in the dreamlands!

**The plugin is in ALPHA state, do not use it in public production servers or always use it together with something like InventoryRollback**

## Features
- Separate inventory
- Persistent inventory
- Separate world spawn
- Dying wakes player up
- Keep inevntory
- Send players back when it's day
- Customizable world generation

![Screenshot of the dreamlands, a lot of ellipsoid islands floating, some of them have trees.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5ef42faa9b9bc7d4c5a74b6cf603eb0e3fdda78a.png)
